FROZEN_TARGET.statement: For every reachable prefix s of the fixed HPS rank-1 random-swap factorization for the exact STS31 Levi base, determine whether there exists a deterministic poly(r)-bit algorithm computing either the exact conditional expected new-spectrum characteristic polynomial p_s(x)=E[chi_new(x)|s], or a strictly weaker exact equality-safe certificate sufficient to deterministically identify a child preserving the required common-interlacing largest-root bound.

sources.source: Chris Hall, Doron Puder, William F. Sawin, Ramanujan Coverings of Graphs, Advances in Mathematics 323 (2018), arXiv:1506.02335
bound_facts: Conditional averages arising from rank-1 random permutation factors are real-rooted and sibling branches admit common-interlacing descent.
For S_r, Remark 4.7 gives a recursive realization of the uniform permutation using binom(r,2) rank-1 random swaps.
The source establishes existence of a good child but does not state a deterministic output-polynomial evaluator for every partially fixed HPS node of the frozen STS31 base.

sources.source: Michael B. Cohen, Ramanujan Graphs in Polynomial Time, FOCS 2016, arXiv:1604.03544
bound_facts: A different interlacing family does admit polynomial-time exact partially specified expected-characteristic-polynomial computation.
Its key closure uses the special union-of-perfect-matchings/bipartite-block structure, quadrature, and symbolic determinant computation.
This is strong positive prior art for the algorithmic-interlacing idea but is not a theorem for arbitrary HPS fixed-base covers or the exact STS31 conditional state.

sources.source: Nikhil Srivastava, Ramanujan Graphs and Interlacing Families, arXiv:2412.20721
sources.bound_fact: Reports that polynomial-time finding of Ramanujan 2-covers or n-covers of arbitrary base graphs is not known and that relevant exact expected characteristic polynomial computations are #P-hard in general settings.

sources.source: Approximating the Largest Root and Applications to Interlacing Families, arXiv:1704.03892
sources.bound_fact: Top-coefficient access can support root approximation/subexponential interlacing algorithms, but this does not supply the frozen exact equality-safe poly(r) selector.

sources.source: Zachary Hamaker, Brendon Rhoades, Partial permutations and character evaluations, arXiv:2503.17552; accepted Combinatorial Theory (reported 2026)
sources.bound_fact: Provides explicit character-evaluation machinery for group-algebra sums over permutations extending partial mappings, using path/cycle decomposition.

sources.source: Valentin Feray, Partial Jucys-Murphy elements and star factorizations, European Journal of Combinatorics 33 (2012), arXiv:0904.4854
sources.bound_fact: Shows a relevant partial-permutation/Jucys-Murphy algebraic neighborhood for products and counts of star transpositions; used here only as a discovery bridge, not proof authority for selector closure.

MINIMUM_INFORMATION_RESULT.invariant: At every selected node s, lambda_max(p_s)<=rho where rho=sqrt(14)+sqrt(2).
MINIMUM_INFORMATION_RESULT.common_interlacing_consequence: Because at least one child has lambda_max no larger than the parent and siblings have common interlacing, every child has at most one root strictly above rho.

counterexample_at_rho_1.conclusion: f_child(rho)>=0 does not distinguish a bad equality child from a good equality child.

derivative_jet_intermediate_lemma.statement: If m is the multiplicity of rho as a root of a child f, then sign(f^(m)(rho)) equals (-1)^k where k is the number of roots strictly above rho; under the at-most-one-above invariant, positive means good and negative means bad.
derivative_jet_intermediate_lemma.limitation: Worst-case m can grow with degree, so this is a semantic certificate but not yet a computational compression theorem.

shifted_threshold_scalar_lemma.statement: There is an explicitly representable rational epsilon_r>0 with polynomially many bits such that z_r=rho+epsilon_r lies strictly between rho and every root of every reachable child conditional polynomial that is strictly greater than rho. Then sign(p_child(z_r)) is positive iff lambda_max(p_child)<=rho and negative iff lambda_max(p_child)>rho.
shifted_threshold_scalar_lemma.why_equality_safe: A root exactly at rho lies below z_r and contributes a positive factor; if a distinct root lies above rho, root separation ensures it lies above z_r, giving exactly one negative factor.
shifted_threshold_scalar_lemma.root_separation_basis: Reachable conditional polynomials have degree O(r) and rational coefficient bit length polynomial in r; after clearing denominators and adjoining the fixed degree-4 algebraic rho, standard resultant/Mignotte-type algebraic root-separation bounds give distance at least 2^{-poly(r)} for any unequal root.
shifted_threshold_scalar_lemma.computability_status: THE_SIGN_IS_SUFFICIENT_IF_THE_CONDITIONAL EXPECTATION VALUE_CAN_BE COMPUTED; THAT EVALUATION ALGORITHM IS NOT PROVED HERE

MINIMUM_INFORMATION_RESULT.C4_barrier_potential: NO_SOURCE_BOUND_EXACT_CHILD_SELECTOR_FOUND; BARRIER_METHODS_DO_NOT_BY_THEMSELVES SUPPLY THE REQUIRED CONDITIONAL EVALUATOR

WEAKER_CERTIFICATE_ROUTES.sturm: VALID_IF_REQUIRED_POLYNOMIAL_OR_STURM_DATA_CAN_BE COMPUTED; NO INDEPENDENT POLYTIME CONDITIONAL GENERATOR PROVED

LOW_RANK_SWAP_ANALYSIS.leaf_level_fact: For a fixed completion of all future random choices, sibling matrices differ by a constant-rank modification because a transposition differs from identity by rank one in the standard representation; the symmetric adjacency realization gives a constant-rank whole-matrix update.
LOW_RANK_SWAP_ANALYSIS.useful_identity: Matrix determinant lemma/resolvent identities therefore express a leaf-level determinant difference through constant-order cofactor/adjugate data.
LOW_RANK_SWAP_ANALYSIS.first_closure_problem: After averaging over future random swaps, expected determinant alone is not closed. Updating expected first-order cofactor data through another random overlapping low-rank update introduces higher compound-minor correlations.
LOW_RANK_SWAP_ANALYSIS.hierarchy: determinant -> first compound/adjugate -> second compounds -> higher compounds
LOW_RANK_SWAP_ANALYSIS.naive_full_compound_state: Potentially exponential because the total number of all k-minors at middle k is exponential in matrix dimension Theta(r).

CONDITIONAL_SYMMETRY_COMPRESSION.frozen_prefix_shape_observation: Under the frozen global edge-then-swap order, a reachable prefix has a constant number of earlier base edges fully fixed, at most one current base edge partially randomized, and later base edges still at their original HPS distributions; this is narrower than an arbitrary simultaneous partial conditioning on all 465 edges.
positive_structure: The base has only 465 edges, a fixed constant.
HPS Remark 4.7 recursively factors uniform S_r permutations into star-like rank-1 random swaps involving a newly introduced sheet.
Hamaker-Rhoades partial-permutation character sums and Jucys-Murphy/star-transposition algebra provide plausible representation-theoretic compression languages.
CONDITIONAL_SYMMETRY_COMPRESSION.unclosed_step: No theorem was found or derived showing that the exact conditional determinant expectation or shifted-threshold delta evaluation depends on only r^O(1) orbit/character statistics for every reachable prefix.
CONDITIONAL_SYMMETRY_COMPRESSION.red_team: Enumerating all irreducible S_r sectors/partition types is not automatically polynomial, and a prefix product of weighted noncommuting id/transposition factors is not automatically a uniform partial-permutation extension class.

FIXED_BASE_DP_ANALYSIS.allowed_asymptotic_shape: r^C for any constant C depending only on the frozen 186-vertex/465-edge base
FIXED_BASE_DP_ANALYSIS.positive_root_case: The unconditional d-matching polynomial uses r^465 projected count vectors, proving that a grotesque fixed exponent is still legal under the output-polynomial contract.
FIXED_BASE_DP_ANALYSIS.conditional_obstruction: Frozen earlier edge permutations create named sheet-identification constraints and support-overlap information. Collapsing them to occupancy counts is sound only if all collapsed states have identical future conditional expectations.
FIXED_BASE_DP_ANALYSIS.no_identity_collapse_proof: No such exact quotient/closure theorem was obtained for all HPS prefixes.

DELTA_CHILD_COMPRESSION.scalar_specialization: At z_r, if p_s(z_r) is carried from the chosen parent, one exact scalar Delta_s(z_r) reconstructs both child scalar certificates.
DELTA_CHILD_COMPRESSION.root_initialization: p_root(z_r) is exactly computable from the already certified fixed-base unconditional polynomial computation.
DELTA_CHILD_COMPRESSION.selection: Compute both reconstructed child values exactly; by the shifted-threshold lemma at least one is positive; choose the first positive child in frozen order and carry its scalar value.

FIRST_FUTURE_BREAK.broken_step: Averaging the next update requires cross-minor/higher-compound correlations not determined by the scalar determinant expectation and the current local cofactor alone.
FIRST_FUTURE_BREAK.small_matrix_reason: For a symmetric 2x2 K=[[a,b],[b,c]], det(K) and the single cofactor C11=c can be held fixed while b varies with a adjusted to preserve det; a subsequent update in direction (1,1) depends on (1,1)^T adj(K)(1,1)=a+c-2b, which changes. Thus determinant plus the prior local cofactor is not a closed state for overlapping update directions.

HRAIN_RED_TEAM.coefficient_blowup: NOT_THE_DOMINANT_BLOCKER; BIT LENGTH HAS A POLYNOMIAL UPPER BOUND

INAIHR_CANDIDATES.why: Common interlacing plus root separation turns it into an exact good/bad child predicate.
INAIHR_CANDIDATES.state_size: one fixed-degree algebraic scalar if evaluable
INAIHR_CANDIDATES.killer: Failure to compute the conditional expectation scalar without exponential summation.

INAIHR_CANDIDATES.why: Parent value plus delta reconstructs both child certificates.
INAIHR_CANDIDATES.state_size: one carried parent scalar plus one computed delta scalar
INAIHR_CANDIDATES.killer: No closed poly(r) update across overlapping future swaps.

INAIHR_CANDIDATES.exact_property: Character/orbit statistics of weighted partial permutation products
INAIHR_CANDIDATES.why: May compress the one-current-edge conditional distribution and later uniform symmetries.
INAIHR_CANDIDATES.killer: Superpolynomial number of relevant sectors or lack of closure for weighted ordered random-swap products.

INAIHR_CANDIDATES.exact_property: Exploit the recursive star-transposition structure of the HPS S_r factorization
INAIHR_CANDIDATES.why: May diagonalize or recursively evaluate selected group-algebra observables without enumerating permutations.
INAIHR_CANDIDATES.killer: The determinant observable may couple too many representation sectors or the ordered weighted factors may not lie in a polynomial-size closed commutative algebra.

INAIHR_CANDIDATES.exact_property: Replace remaining permutation average by a tractable orthogonal/quadrature operator and symbolic determinant
INAIHR_CANDIDATES.why: This succeeds for Cohen's matching interlacing family with exactly the complete-plus-one-partial-plus-future-uniform shape.
INAIHR_CANDIDATES.killer: No theorem transfers the needed quadrature closure to the 465-edge STS31 HPS adjacency-sum geometry.

agreement: Full p_s is not semantically necessary.
Raw sign at rho is equality-unsafe.
Shifted threshold sign is an exact sufficient predicate once a uniform separation-safe epsilon_r is fixed.
No current proof computes the required scalar delta at every prefix in poly(r) bit complexity.
disagreement_or_unresolved: iNaiHR rates partial-permutation/Jucys-Murphy compression as the strongest representation bridge; HRAiN has not verified polynomial sector count or closure.
iNaiHR sees Cohen-style quadrature as a close algorithmic analogue; HRAiN rejects direct transfer without a theorem for the STS31 multi-edge geometry.
Fixed-base r^C DP remains plausible; HRAiN has no future-equivalence quotient proving count-vector sufficiency.

COMPLEXITY_CERTIFICATE.swap_probabilities: Rational with O(log r)-bit local numerators/denominators in the explicit HPS construction
COMPLEXITY_CERTIFICATE.conditional_weight_denominator_bit_bound: O(r^2 log r) by multiplying at most O(r^2) local denominators
COMPLEXITY_CERTIFICATE.leaf_coefficient_magnitude: 2^{O(r log r)} or better from standard determinant/eigenvalue coefficient bounds for an O(r)-dimensional bounded-degree adjacency representation
COMPLEXITY_CERTIFICATE.conditional_coefficient_bit_length: r^O(1); a coarse O(r^2 log r) bound suffices for the separation argument
COMPLEXITY_CERTIFICATE.epsilon_r: Can be chosen as 2^{-poly(r)} with polynomial encoding length using a uniform root-separation bound derived from degree and height bounds.
COMPLEXITY_CERTIFICATE.exact_sign_arithmetic: Evaluation at z_r=rho+epsilon_r lies in the fixed degree-4 number field Q(rho); exact zero/sign decisions are polynomial in operand bit length once the expected scalar is available.

VERDICT.reason: A strictly weaker exact equality-safe child certificate has been proved to exist semantically, and the per-node information requirement compresses to one exact shifted-threshold delta scalar, but no deterministic r^O(1)-bit algorithm or source-bound theorem computes that scalar for every reachable frozen HPS prefix. No rigorous lower bound or impossibility theorem falsifies the entire target.

BEST_SURVIVING_CANDIDATE.decision: reconstruct both child values and choose first positive child
BEST_SURVIVING_CANDIDATE.why_best: It is strictly smaller than computing the complete conditional polynomial and explicitly resolves equality.

EXACT_FIRST_BROKEN_STEP.statement: Leaf-level low-rank determinant difference does not by itself yield a closed expected-state recurrence; after an overlapping future random swap, the natural determinant/cofactor state requests higher compound-minor correlations unless additional symmetry compression is proved.

SMALLEST_NEW_MISSING_LEMMA.statement: For every r>=1 and every reachable prefix s of the frozen HPS random-swap decision order, let z_r=rho+epsilon_r be the fixed separation-safe algebraic threshold and let the next binary swap have probability alpha_s. Compute exactly Delta_s(z_r)=p_{s0}(z_r)-p_{s1}(z_r) in r^O(1) bit operations and r^O(1) space from a polynomial-size state, with closure under all subsequent support overlaps and with all produced algebraic/rational bit lengths polynomial in r.
SMALLEST_NEW_MISSING_LEMMA.why_sufficient_if_proved: The unconditional root value p_root(z_r) is already exactly computable; parent-plus-delta reconstructs both child shifted-threshold values, whose signs exactly certify lambda_max<=rho. Repeating the certified local step would then be subject to a separate full-path composition gate before target A can change status.

NEXT_SINGLE_GATE.scope: Preregister only the smallest new missing lemma: exact poly(r)-bit evaluation of Delta_s(z_r) at every reachable frozen prefix. Freeze the separation-safe z_r construction, exact carried-parent scalar interface, allowed representation/Jucys-Murphy/fixed-base-DP/quadrature routes, closure-under-overlap requirement, and candidate-specific killer falsifiers. Do not execute its proof automatically.

SELF_HANDOFF_JSON.major_compression: p_s plus one scalar Delta_s(z_r) determines both child certificates
